subject: Creativity
title: South Korea's Creative Miracle: From War to Hallyu
description: A short lesson to help you apply South Korea's Creative Miracle: From War to Hallyu.

hook.text: In 1960, South Korea was poorer than Ghana. By 2023, Korean pop culture generates $12 billion annually.

buildup.text: After the 1997 Asian financial crisis, Korea invested in cultural industries — creating an export boom.

discovery.text: The 'Hallyu' (Korean Wave) was engineered: government funded creative infrastructure, K-pop agencies developed.

twist.text: BTS alone contributed $5 billion per year to Korea's GDP. One band's creative output became macroeconomic policy.

climax.text: Korea proved that creativity isn't just art — it's national economic strategy.

punchline.text: Korea didn't wait for creativity to happen. It built an industry.

quiz.question: How much did BTS contribute annually to South Korea's GDP?
